_about: Outreach claim OC-17. Read by app/what-you-get and checked by scripts/outreach_scoped_councils.py, which computes the list from the database and fails unless this file names exactly the councils that pass. Do not edit by hand to add a council: make it pass, then run the check, which prints the list.
claim: For the councils listed, every rule shown carries the council's own sentence and the clause it came from, in the plan registered as in force. Known exceptions are stated.

exceptions.statement: Canterbury-Bankstown chapters 10.2 Schools, 10.3 Home businesses, 10.4 Non-residential land uses and 10.5 Places of public worship are shown for every development type, because the property search cannot yet ask for those uses.
